name: @sos-2/api-contracts
description: SOS 2.0 API Contracts (Work Order P2): the typed boundary of the live API surface — transport-agnostic request/response envelopes, typed error envelopes (UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, CONFLICT/stale-revision, DUPLICATE/replayed, NOT_FOUND, INVALID), opaque pagination cursors, revision headers, event ingestion payloads and provider-health payloads. Pure types + guards; zero external runtime dependencies (the only dependency is the workspace spine, whose vocabulary — canonical serialization and the frozen truth states — is consumed verbatim and never redefined; Work Order P2, spec/productization-requirements.md 'Providers remain adapters', docs/deployment/free-tier-plan.md).
